text: updatePriority is dispatched as a function and uses document.l10n to assign one of three status-priority-img-* messages to an HTML image. Those messages define .alt; they are not value-only strings read through this.l10n. For none, the updater collapses the panel, removes the localization ID and src, and sets alt to empty. The fixed source retains this state cleanup. The migration copies the existing priority patterns into the new attributes. No changed test directly verifies the image alternative text or the localization callback path. The mouseover preview separately retains value-only high-priority, normal-priority and low-priority through its own lazy localization getter; those old values remain alongside the new image attributes.
title: Calendar priority images localize their alt attribute through the document
